lines.zh: 我落在麦田边，先看有没有人。
lines.en: I land at the wheat field's edge and check for people first.

lines.zh: 三只同伴在我后面，翅膀扇得整齐。
lines.en: Three flockmates behind me, wings beating in time.

lines.zh: 我一跳一跳地走，翅膀半张着。
lines.en: I hop along, wings half open for a quick exit.

lines.zh: 麦穗在我嘴里断成两截。
lines.en: The wheat ear snaps in two inside my beak.

lines.zh: 我绕着干草捆走，不肯靠近南瓜。
lines.en: I circle the hay bale, refusing to come near the pumpkin.

lines.zh: 田埂上留着我的细爪印。
lines.en: Tiny claw prints trail along the field ridge.

lines.zh: 我飞过篱笆，落在最高的麦秆上。
lines.en: I fly over the fence and perch on the tallest stalk.

lines.zh: 队伍散开，把整块田分成几份。
lines.en: The flock spreads out, dividing the field among us.

lines.zh: 我低头啄胡萝卜叶，像在挑刺。
lines.en: I peck the carrot leaves as if picking fault.

lines.zh: 南瓜头立在田中央，我们绕它飞。
lines.en: A pumpkin head stands mid-field; we fly around it.

lines.zh: 翅膀擦过麦芒，沙沙作响。
lines.en: My wings brush the wheat awns with a dry rustle.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚步，等田里安静。
lines.en: I trail your footsteps, waiting for the field to quiet.

lines.zh: 我们一群落下，田里立刻吵起来。
lines.en: We land as one flock, and the field turns noisy.

lines.zh: 我边走边看天，风吹草动都像陷阱。
lines.en: I walk watching the sky; every stir looks like a trap.

lines.zh: 我落在篱笆上，先理翅膀。
lines.en: I land on the fence and groom first.

lines.zh: 我在田里跳一步，啄一下。
lines.en: One hop in the field, one peck.

lines.zh: 同伴飞起来，我才跟上。
lines.en: When my flock lifts, I follow.

lines.zh: 我沿着田垄走，找落下的麦粒。
lines.en: I walk the furrow hunting fallen grain.

lines.zh: 我站在木桩上，把羽毛理整齐。
lines.en: I perch on the post and preen my feathers straight.

lines.zh: 远处稻草人不动，我看它很久。
lines.en: The scarecrow never moves; I watch it a long while.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，只发出短短的哑叫。
lines.en: I open my beak and give a short, hoarse caw.

lines.zh: 同伴落在旁边，我们谁也不出声。
lines.en: A flockmate lands beside me and neither of us speaks.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我就想起要飞走。
lines.en: One gust and I remember I should fly.

lines.zh: 我用爪抓了抓木头，留几道痕。
lines.en: I rake the wood with my claws, leaving a few marks.

lines.zh: 稻草人顶着南瓜，我偏不看它。
lines.en: The scarecrow wears a pumpkin; I refuse to look at it.

lines.zh: 太阳偏了，我的影子也偏了。
lines.en: The sun shifts, and so does my shadow.

lines.zh: 我把头埋进翅膀，听泥土动。
lines.en: I tuck my head in my wing and listen to the soil.

lines.zh: 一粒麦掉在地上，我没去捡。
lines.en: A grain falls to the ground; I let it lie.

lines.zh: 我们排成一排，等下一阵风。
lines.en: We line up along the branch and wait for wind.

lines.zh: 羽毛上沾了露，我抖了抖身子。
lines.en: Dew clings to my feathers, so I shake myself.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，一只眼换另一只眼。
lines.en: I tilt my head, trading one eye for the other.

lines.zh: 你手里没有麦子，我照样盯着。
lines.en: No wheat in your hands, and still I stare.

lines.zh: 我认出你昨天赶过我们。
lines.en: I remember you chased us off yesterday.

lines.zh: 你走近一步，我的翅膀就松一分。
lines.en: You take one step, and my wings loosen a notch.

lines.zh: 我盯着你头上的东西，别是南瓜。
lines.en: I watch what is on your head; not a pumpkin, I hope.

lines.zh: 你没举稻草人，我就敢多看一会儿。
lines.en: You raise no scarecrow, so I dare watch a while longer.

lines.zh: 我的黑眼珠里映着一整片麦田。
lines.en: A whole wheat field is mirrored in my black eye.

lines.zh: 你蹲下，我也蹲下，脖子缩紧。
lines.en: You crouch, and I crouch, neck drawn in.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，群里的都抬头看你。
lines.en: I caw once, and the flock all looks at you.

lines.zh: 你若抬手，我先飞三丈再回头。
lines.en: Raise your hand, and I fly thirty feet before looking back.

lines.zh: 一根箭穿过翅膀，我掉进麦里。
lines.en: An arrow through my wing drops me into the wheat.

lines.zh: 我的叫声断了半截。
lines.en: My caw breaks off halfway.

lines.zh: 羽毛落了一地，像被撕开的信。
lines.en: Feathers scatter like a torn letter.

lines.zh: 翅膀折了，我只能跳着躲。
lines.en: My wing is broken; I can only hop away.

lines.zh: 疼让我忘了整群，只顾自己飞。
lines.en: Pain makes me forget the flock and fly alone.

lines.zh: 你打中我的胸口，我翻了个跟头。
lines.en: You hit my chest and I tumble head over tail.

lines.zh: 血滴在墓碑上，颜色很暗。
lines.en: Blood drips on the headstone, very dark.

lines.zh: 我挣扎着站起，一条腿使不上力。
lines.en: I struggle up; one leg will not bear weight.

lines.zh: 同伴围着我叫，却不敢落下。
lines.en: The flock cries around me but will not land.

lines.zh: 再来一下，我就只剩羽毛了。
lines.en: One more blow and only feathers remain.

lines.zh: 你撒下的种子，我一颗颗啄走。
lines.en: I peck up the seeds you scatter, one by one.

lines.zh: 我不靠近你，只靠近那堆麦粒。
lines.en: I come not to you but to the pile of grain.

lines.zh: 你退开两步，我才肯落地。
lines.en: You step back two paces before I deign to land.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜叶子比你的手更香。
lines.en: Carrot leaves smell sweeter than your hand.

lines.zh: 我叼一粒就跑，跑远再吃。
lines.en: I grab one grain and run, eating it far off.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我跳到你够不到的地方。
lines.en: You reach out; I hop just beyond your reach.

lines.zh: 南瓜不算食物，我只绕着它转。
lines.en: A pumpkin is not food; I only circle it.

lines.zh: 整群都下来了，你的种子不够分。
lines.en: The whole flock descends; your seeds will not go round.

lines.zh: 我听见袋子响，就知道有吃的。
lines.en: I hear the bag rustle and know there is food.

lines.zh: 吃饱了我就飞走，不说谢谢。
lines.en: When I am full I fly off, without a word of thanks.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我整只鸟弹开三尺。
lines.en: You bump me and I bounce three feet away.

lines.zh: 翅膀先张开，身体才想起要逃。
lines.en: My wings open first; my body remembers to flee after.

lines.zh: 我被挤得侧翻，羽毛落了两根。
lines.en: I tip sideways, dropping two feathers.

lines.zh: 一声短叫，附近的同伴全飞起来。
lines.en: One short cry, and every nearby flockmate takes off.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀擦过，我记住了这个味道。
lines.en: Your shoulder grazes me; I remember that smell.

lines.zh: 我摔在麦茬上，赶紧站直。
lines.en: I tumble onto the stubble and straighten up fast.

lines.zh: 脚下打滑，我扑腾着才停住。
lines.en: My feet slip; I flap hard to stop.

lines.zh: 整群散开，像被风吹散的谷壳。
lines.en: The flock bursts apart like chaff in wind.

lines.zh: 我退到田埂，等你先走。
lines.en: I retreat to the ridge and wait for you to pass.

lines.zh: 撞得不重，可我的面子掉了。
lines.en: The hit was light, but my dignity fell off.

lines.zh: 我一跳避开，落点还是你的脚边。
lines.en: One hop avoids you; I land at your feet anyway.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的影子，我也躲。
lines.en: You step on my shadow and I dodge that too.

lines.zh: 我把最亮的一根羽毛递过去。
lines.en: I offer the brightest feather I have.

lines.zh: 她落在旁边，我们就并排站着。
lines.en: She lands beside me and we stand side by side.

lines.zh: 我绕着巢飞两圈，再收翅膀。
lines.en: I circle the nest twice before folding my wings.

lines.zh: 枝上铺的干草，是我们一起叼的。
lines.en: The hay on the branch we carried together.

lines.zh: 我叫得比平时轻，怕吓着她。
lines.en: I call softer than usual, so as not to startle her.

lines.zh: 两只鸟一起盯着田，谁也不动。
lines.en: Two birds watch the field and neither moves.

lines.zh: 她啄我的颈毛，我站着不动。
lines.en: She nibbles my neck feathers; I hold still.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在麦上叠成一个。
lines.en: Our shadows fold into one on the wheat.

lines.zh: 巢里三颗蛋，颜色像脏石头。
lines.en: Three eggs in the nest, colored like dirty stones.

lines.zh: 等雏鸟会飞，这田就归它们。
lines.en: When the chicks fly, this field is theirs.

lines.zh: 地上有块金粒，我叼了又放下。
lines.en: A gold nugget lies there; I pick it up and drop it.

lines.zh: 我抓起那根线头，以为是虫子。
lines.en: I grab the loose thread, mistaking it for a worm.

lines.zh: 这片羽毛不是我的，但我收下。
lines.en: This feather is not mine, but I keep it.

lines.zh: 我把麦粒含在嘴里，没咽。
lines.en: I hold the grain in my beak without swallowing.

lines.zh: 亮的东西我都想叼走，不管有用没用。
lines.en: Anything shiny I try to carry off, useful or not.

lines.zh: 你掉落的东西里，我只挑谷子。
lines.en: Of what you dropped, I take only the grain.

lines.zh: 我叼起一颗种子，飞了三步。
lines.en: I lift a seed and fly three hops away.

lines.zh: 这块腐肉我不吃，也带走。
lines.en: This rotten flesh I will not eat, but I take it.

lines.zh: 嘴里塞满了，我还能再叼一根。
lines.en: My beak is full, and I still find room for one more.

lines.zh: 我把东西藏进树缝，转身就忘。
lines.en: I stash it in a tree crack and forget it at once.

lines.zh: 我看见田里有东西在动，就压低身子。
lines.en: Something moves in the field; I drop low.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了一排麦子，这笔账记下了。
lines.en: You crushed a row of wheat; that is noted.

lines.zh: 同伴叫了一声，我们全转向你。
lines.en: A flockmate calls, and we all turn toward you.

lines.zh: 我先飞起来，看清你有几只手。
lines.en: I take off first, to count your hands.

lines.zh: 别以为乌鸦不敢啄人。
lines.en: Do not think a crow will not peck a person.

lines.zh: 你手里的面包屑，现在是我们的目标。
lines.en: The crumbs in your hand are our target now.

lines.zh: 我落到你背后那根桩上。
lines.en: I land on the post behind you.

lines.zh: 整群压低，像一片黑云贴着麦尖。
lines.en: The flock drops low, a black cloud on the wheat tips.

lines.zh: 你一举南瓜，我们立刻改了主意。
lines.en: You raise a pumpkin and we change our minds.

lines.zh: 选好了，就是你帽檐上那点红。
lines.en: Chosen: that red thing on your hat brim.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手腕，那里最容易松。
lines.en: I watch your wrist; it is the first to loosen.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我就在枝上挪一步。
lines.en: Each step you take, I shuffle along the branch.

lines.zh: 翅膀半张，只等一个空隙。
lines.en: Wings half open, waiting for one gap.

lines.zh: 我不叫了，叫一声会暴露位置。
lines.en: I stop calling; a call would give me away.

lines.zh: 你身后的同伴已经绕过去了。
lines.en: A flockmate has already gone around behind you.

lines.zh: 南瓜的味道让我犹豫，只一下。
lines.en: The smell of pumpkin makes me hesitate, just once.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，第三步就动。
lines.en: I count your steps; I move on the third.

lines.zh: 你抬头找我，我已经换了枝。
lines.en: You look up for me; I have changed branches.

lines.zh: 整群都静了，静才是要动手。
lines.en: The whole flock has gone quiet; quiet means we begin.

lines.zh: 你背对着田，这是最好的时机。
lines.en: Your back is to the field; this is the best moment.

lines.zh: 我啄你的手背，一下就走。
lines.en: I peck the back of your hand and am gone.

lines.zh: 嘴尖撞在骨头上，震得我发麻。
lines.en: My beak hits bone and my whole head rings.

lines.zh: 我扑上你的帽子，抓了两下。
lines.en: I fly at your hat and rake it twice.

lines.zh: 你甩手，我在半空翻了个身。
lines.en: You swing your arm; I roll over in midair.

lines.zh: 群鸟一起落下，像下了一场黑雨。
lines.en: The flock drops together like a rain of black.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的袖口，往后拽。
lines.en: I clamp your sleeve and pull backward.

lines.zh: 这一啄是给昨天那声吼的。
lines.en: This peck is for that shout yesterday.

lines.zh: 你护住脸，我就去啄你的耳朵。
lines.en: You cover your face, so I go for your ear.

lines.zh: 羽毛乱飞，你也分不清哪只是我。
lines.en: Feathers fly and you cannot tell which one is me.

lines.zh: 打完就散，我们从不留下。
lines.en: When it ends we scatter; we never linger.

lines.zh: 夜里我从树梢落进这片墓园。
lines.en: At night I drop from the treetops into this graveyard.

lines.zh: 先来一只，再来的就是一群。
lines.en: One arrives first; the rest come as a crowd.

lines.zh: 我在墓碑上站稳，理了理翅膀。
lines.en: I settle on a headstone and tidy my wings.

lines.zh: 麦田就在旁边，我闻到了。
lines.en: The wheat field is close; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 雾还没散，我已经在数稻草人。
lines.en: The mist has not lifted and I am already counting scarecrows.

lines.zh: 远处有南瓜灯，我们绕开那块地。
lines.en: A jack-o'-lantern glows; we avoid that patch.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的露水让我飞得歪。
lines.en: Dew on my wings makes my flight crooked.

lines.zh: 这地方安静，适合落一群乌鸦。
lines.en: A quiet place, fit for a flock of crows.

lines.zh: 我从黑暗里来，带着一根掉羽。
lines.en: I come out of the dark with one loose feather.

lines.zh: 天亮前我们会走，现在先吃。
lines.en: We leave before dawn; for now, we eat.

lines.zh: 火一沾上羽毛，我整只鸟都亮了。
lines.en: Fire catches my feathers and I become a torch.

lines.zh: 从高处坠下，翅膀来不及张开。
lines.en: Falling, my wings cannot open in time.

lines.zh: 水灌进羽毛，我再也浮不起来。
lines.en: Water soaks my feathers and I cannot rise.

lines.zh: 爆炸的气浪把我和羽毛一起掀翻。
lines.en: The blast flips me and my feathers together.

lines.zh: 箭把我钉在木桩上，我还在挣。
lines.en: The arrow pins me to the post; I still struggle.

lines.zh: 魔法的光裹住我，羽毛根根竖起。
lines.en: Magic light wraps me and every feather stands up.

lines.zh: 田里没有麦子了，我饿得发晕。
lines.en: The field is bare; hunger makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 雷落在附近，我的羽毛全焦了。
lines.en: Lightning lands nearby and scorches my feathers.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有风，我张着翅膀一直掉。
lines.en: No wind in the void; I fall with wings spread.
